offering_description.value: Publishes local daily and weekly newspapers and their websites across many US markets, selling subscriptions and advertising. Also provides digital marketing and advertising services to local businesses, delivered through its own print and online platforms.

primary_products.value: daily newspapers; weekly newspapers; digital news subscriptions; specialty print publications

primary_services.value: digital marketing services; local advertising; commercial printing and distribution

customer_segment.value: B2C: newspaper and digital subscribers and readers in local communities; B2B: local businesses and advertisers buying advertising and marketing services

end_markets.value: local news and media; local advertising; small business marketing

revenue_model.value: subscription: print and digital news subscriptions; advertising: print and digital advertising from local businesses; service fees: digital marketing services and printing/distribution for other publishers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns local newspaper brands and websites, producing news content for readers and advertisers; service provider: digital marketing solutions sold to local small and mid-sized businesses

geography_served.value: US national: Local markets in roughly 25 states

specialization.value: related lines: newspapers, digital subscriptions, advertising and digital marketing services

distribution_channels.value: online: news websites, apps and digital subscriptions; direct sales: sales staff selling advertising and marketing services to local businesses; other: home delivery, mail carriers and single-copy newsstand sales

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business, advertising, privacy and postal rules apply
